name: This Date is TOAST(r)
source:
A weird dating app has appeared on your phone, and you've matched with three people! Pick one, and go on a (bad) date with our characters in this short, cute visual novel. 

[From [url=https://princegeist.itch.io/toastr]itch.io[/url]]
